## Context

- Related issue(s), if any: <!-- Use Closes #123 when appropriate. -->
- Prior discussion for new features, large refactors, dependency/support-policy changes or breaking/significant public API changes: <!-- Link or explain why not applicable. -->

## Summary

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Keep one focused change per PR.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and their results. Explain relevant manual checks or limits.

## Checklist

- [ ] My account is already in the default branch's approved contributor list, or I am an existing repository maintainer.
- [ ] Any new feature, large refactor, dependency/support-policy change or breaking/significant public API change was discussed before implementation.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass and tests cover changed behavior where needed.
- [ ] User documentation, API contracts and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated where required.
- [ ] No generated artifacts, credentials, private data or unrelated changes are included.
